item.title: Probabilistic multi-horizon spatiotemporal forecasting of injection-induced seismicity in geothermal systems
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 24 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04200-9

QuakeCastNet forecasts seismicity rates and spatial distributions at two geothermal sites, where the network improves early forecasts, decay adaptation addresses shut-in conditions absent from network training, and the sites show contrasting temporal and spatial responses.
